evidence.name: Screen field: The featured image up top
evidence.userNeed: Know what "The featured image up top" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: The featured image up top
sections.description: The hero is the large featured image at the top of a headline or wheel-picker screen, the picture that sells the screen at a glance. Turn it on, then upload a file or paste an image URL. Pick a high-quality, on-message visual (product, result, or lifestyle shot); on a paid landing page it is often the first thing a visitor sees. Sizing and position are set just below.
